question: Does the S5 identity floor lift under a narrow LR/schedule bracket with correct row-LR propagation, holding all S5 arms/seeds/mixtures fixed?
claim_ceiling: S6 can only re-adjudicate the S5 contrasts on a resolved instrument; it cannot authorize tokenizer/vocabulary change, scale, cognition or AGI claims.
hardware_target: Kaggle GPU T4 x2, exact-resume, wall-guarded (same ops as S5)

surface.development: same frozen S5 public development rows
surface.sealed: same sealed commitments, consumed once after dev freeze

model_and_optimizer.geometry: exact frozen S5 8L/256w V24576 tied-embedding control (M0_STANDARD)
model_and_optimizer.change: row-LR follows main-schedule LR (S6 diff); constant-LR S5 control arm retained for comparison
bracket: LR 3e-3 only if pre-outcome stability proof passes

entry_gate.lr_clip_probe: CHOKED or MIXED on both/either probe lane, OR baseline-gate GO with clip_fraction >= 0.99
entry_gate.otherwise: do not open S6; run metric-resolution audit + baseline gate first

primary: identity formation AUC + identity exact+valid-EOS on M0 per LR, matched seeds
kill_rule: no clip relief AND no formation change across the bracket closes the optimizer line
sealed: one-shot, after development freeze, never steers
